waivers.reason: The runtime entrypoint starts as root only to copy the read-only service-identity key into a mode-0400 tmpfs file owned by uid 10001. It immediately execs the Agent as uid/gid 10001 with cleared supplementary groups and no-new-privileges; application code never runs as root.
waivers.remediation: Replace the root bootstrap with an orchestrator-supported secret mount that can enforce uid 10001 and mode 0400 directly.

waivers.reason: This non-production, per-run verification helper requires access to the Docker socket to create and clean its uniquely named Compose project. It contains no application runtime and is identity-checked and deleted after every run.
waivers.remediation: Move TASK-19 orchestration to a rootless Docker runner with a mapped socket group.
